title: Archive through September 08, 2002 - Anonymous (Thursday, August 22, 2002 - 09:41 pm)
content: I was shot point blank with a 357 magnum & it hit below my right breast. The bleeding was sucking chest wound. A person there had been born with an extra large thumb & he stuck his thumb in the wound -that was squirting out about a foot. While I was on the ground a being that looked like a beautiful angel came to me, above my head & asked me "are you ready to go?" I answered “no I have too many things I have to do” & the angel said "alright, I'll see you again" then I was taken to the hospital. I had another nde later about 1986 related to internal bleeding. I was taken to a hospital in California - they tell me I was dead 12 minutes. I was supposed to be in a coma for the rest of my life. During this time I left my body and went above the cities around the world then I went into the firmament in space. Then, I came to a beautiful cloud in the midst of the dark space. In the middle of the cloud was a massive marble table. On the right of the table were three people dressed in robes. On the other side of the table there were 5 people dressed the same way. One of them seemed to be in charge & they were talking to each other. Then they turned to me & the one in charge motioned for me to come over. I don’t understand what happened then - it seemed like part of me stayed there & part of me went over to him & the others came over too. The talking seemed to go on for a while & then I left & came back to my body. At that time a pastor friend was praying for me, holding my hand, he felt my hand move & I came out of the coma! In the years following I became a chaplain & had spiritual experiences with people I was praying for & with. One time I was praying for a lady that was near death - as I was praying for her I felt like electricity going through my arms. Another time the same thing when I was leading a group in prayer. And one time a man was praying for me in church & I had like a ray going from the bottom of my body going slowly all the way to the top of my head. Once while walking in the back yard- I seemed to walk into another dimension- everything was so bright & beautiful & I had a great feeling of being in total peace- this has happened two times. Another time I was praying for a disabled veteran- an amputee- they were supposed to amputate more of his leg & after praying for him I found out later that they did not amputate anymore of his leg! Praise be to God! I haven't heard of other experiences like this ndr. I met my wife in a way I know god was involved & he sends us on what I call assignments. God puts us in situations where people need prayer & god, then we seem to go to a different areas of the country to a new assignment I believe our biggest assignment is still to come. I now know that there is a God & we all have a particular job to do! I hope I did a good job describing this. My life is completely changed- what matters most now are spiritual matters. And, I believe god has given me my job.

arrival.other_being_detail: A "beautiful angel" appeared above the experiencer's head and asked, "are you ready to go?" Later NDE: groups of robed people (3 on one side of a marble table; 5 on the other) with one "in charge."

environment.environment_other_detail: Described traveling "above the cities around the world," then into "the firmament in space," then to "a beautiful cloud in the midst of the dark space" with a "massive marble table."

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Experiencer said, "no I have too many things I have to do"; later states they became a chaplain, are sent on "assignments" to pray for people, and believes "we all have a particular job to do" and that God "has given me my job."

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Shot point blank with a .357 magnum; later NDE (about 1986) related to internal bleeding and coma.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: First NDE included an angel asking "are you ready to go?" and experiencer answering no. Second NDE included travel above cities/world and into space, then meeting robed figures around a marble table.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Second NDE: OBE travel above cities/world -> space/firmament -> cloud realm with marble table and robed figures -> discussion -> return to body and awakening from coma. First NDE: angel encounter and question/answer while on ground -> taken to hospital.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: During the encounter at the table: "it seemed like part of me stayed there & part of me went over to him."

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Split/dual-presence sensation: "part of me stayed there & part of me went over." Post-NDE prayer-related phenomena described as electricity through arms and a ray moving through the body; twice "walk[ed] into another dimension" with brightness/peace.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "are you ready to go?" / "no I have too many things I have to do" / "alright, I'll see you again" / "they tell me I was dead 12 minutes" / "part of me stayed there & part of me went over"
